description: Apple PNG pasteboard type from the macOS general pasteboard
how: Opened /private/tmp/rclip-capture/bands.png (24x16 truecolour PNG, three vertical colour bands, written by hand with zlib), then Edit > Select All, Edit > Copy.
notes: Byte-identical to public.png. Unlike the HTML, RTF and TIFF legacy names, 'Apple PNG pasteboard type' is not in rclip-core's from_uti table, so it resolves to Flavor::Other while its twin resolves to Png.
